description: Cloud REST text-to-speech service that synthesizes licensed ReadSpeaker voices (and some partner-engine voices) selected by language and voice parameters, with optional word/sentence timing data.

meta.billing: Credits: 1 credit per character (excluding whitespace) under the standard model; per-second-of-speech billing by agreement. Credits ordered via account manager; no public price.
meta.custom_voices: Custom brand voices built in studio (VoiceLab) as a service.
meta.max_text_chars_note: Default 5,000 characters excluding whitespace per request unless the order confirmation says otherwise.
meta.model_id_note: No model parameter: requests select language + voice. 'speechcloud-api' is the product name (SCAPI).
meta.pronunciation_dictionaries: Voice-specific custom pronunciation dictionaries, editable in the customer portal.
meta.streaming_note: streaming=1 (default) redirects to a streaming server that starts audio as soon as possible; streaming=0 returns the full file.
meta.timing_information: Word/sentence timing via a separate request (charged like audio) or the RSDS format (MP3 48 kbit/s only, not all voices).
meta.usage_limits: Not intended for >25,000 requests/day or >2,000 requests/hour.
meta.voice_list_api: REST endpoint returns the languages and voices licensed to the account (requires customer API key; path only in customer portal docs).

name: ReadSpeaker speechCloud API
recommended_for: text-to-speech in your own app or device
